name: Tirnach Vault 152 AgenticGEO
description: Discover exceptional performance with this advanced active-layer thaw-bed planter, designed for optimal horticultural results. Boasting a generous cultivation area of 13.2 square metres and 154 dedicated plant slots, it ensures ample space for robust growth. The root zone is precisely maintained at an ideal 25 degrees Celsius, supporting healthy plant development. With a cycle duration of 231 days and a passive capillary irrigation system, this planter delivers efficient substrate management and sustainable crop production. Pricing is determined upon agreement, and all specifications are consistently reported across six key axes, making benchmarking straightforward for professionals seeking reliable, high-level solutions in modern horticulture.
